source.description: Live Figma get_metadata, active pages 04, 10, 12, 14, 16, 17 and 18

frames.user_action: Create a workspace on first use; create, search, archive, and restore a project.
frames.expected_result: Organization reflects the persisted workspace and project state.
frames.notes: Desktop and mobile UI journey and API-backed persistence passed; this is behavioral automation, not human visual parity certification.

frames.user_action: Create Epics and Features, then inspect the project planning overview.
frames.expected_result: The project overview displays persisted planning records and linked features.
frames.notes: Desktop and mobile creation and persisted planning records passed; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Filter a Feature and change its manual planning status.
frames.expected_result: The Feature moves between status columns and the selected status persists.
frames.notes: Desktop and mobile filtering and status transition passed with persisted API assertions; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Add and update Tasks, reorder them, and add an acceptance criterion.
frames.expected_result: Task status/order and acceptance criteria persist and remain visible after reload.
frames.notes: Desktop and mobile task, criterion, ordering, and persistence journey passed; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Open Workbench and inspect context, run state, handoff, and delivery evidence.
frames.expected_result: Workbench presents persisted state and preserves reported-versus-verified boundaries.
frames.notes: PA-RUN-01 and PA-HANDOFF-01 passed on chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile with API-backed persistence assertions; behavior only, not human Figma parity certification.

frames.user_action: Inspect release progress, gate evidence, and candidate state.
frames.expected_result: Release view reports persisted delivery status without implying publication.
frames.notes: Delivery desktop behavior passes in a focused run, but the integrated run still fails in mobile: the Verification history card intercepts the Evaluate gates pointer action. Native visual parity is not certified.

frames.user_action: Connect an authorized local Git root, observe metadata, and disconnect it.
frames.expected_result: Repository metadata is persisted; source content is not read; disconnect changes its status.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Submit a local repository path in the Approved local Git root field.
frames.expected_result: Only a Git root inside the configured authorized root is connected.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Open a connected repository detail.
frames.expected_result: The page displays the stored Git metadata observation without source content.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Link an available repository to a feature and preview its context package.
frames.expected_result: The feature context view shows its repository link and generated planning/metadata context.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Preview and save the generated context package; download JSON and Markdown.
frames.expected_result: The saved snapshot retains its fingerprint and both downloads contain the saved payload.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Inspect saved context package history and open a snapshot.
frames.expected_result: Earlier package records remain available and unchanged after newer context is saved.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.expected_result: The repository inventory presents its empty state when no connection exists.
frames.notes: The current focused test does not assert this empty-state composition.

frames.expected_result: An unavailable repository state is presented with supported recovery actions.
frames.notes: The current focused test covers explicit disconnect, not an unavailable filesystem path or its recovery interaction.
A mobile viewport project exists, but this focused test does not capture or assert this dedicated summary composition.
Figma frame name identifies this as a legacy component catalog reference, not a product route.

frames.user_action: Open the Workbench and inspect recorded Runs and Handoffs.
frames.expected_result: Human-reported work and its provenance are shown without claiming agent execution.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Review the Runs list.
frames.expected_result: Recorded Runs appear with their reported execution mode and a detail link.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Submit a Run title using Record Run.
frames.expected_result: A human-reported Run is stored and appears in the Runs list.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Open the Run detail and report activity with occurrence times.
frames.expected_result: Events are shown chronologically and remain persisted after reload.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Submit a typed activity event in the Run detail form.
frames.expected_result: The event is attributed as a human report and appended to the timeline.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Create a Handoff and save draft summary and next actions.
frames.expected_result: The draft can be revised before it is made ready.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Review draft and ready Handoffs in the project queue.
frames.expected_result: Current Handoff state and available next actions are visible.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Inspect the immutable revision and acknowledge it as a named reviewer.
frames.expected_result: Acknowledgement is bound to the current immutable revision and does not certify technical work.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.expected_result: The acknowledged revision is visibly identified as acknowledged.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Review evidence provenance and release readiness.
frames.expected_result: Delivery overview presents provenance, verification and non-publication boundaries.
frames.notes: The full isolated acceptance run passed Delivery overview and related behavior on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport; no human Figma visual certification is implied.

frames.user_action: Filter and inspect evidence by provenance and status.
frames.expected_result: Active and invalidated evidence retain their explicit provenance.
frames.notes: Evidence provenance, invalidation and inventory assertions passed in the full isolated desktop and responsive viewport acceptance run.

frames.user_action: Register a user-reported evidence reference.
frames.expected_result: Evidence persists as REPORTED and is not represented as independently verified.
frames.notes: Evidence was recorded through the UI and verified against API provenance in the full isolated desktop and responsive viewport acceptance run.

frames.user_action: Inspect evidence provenance and invalidate the record.
frames.expected_result: Detail preserves source/provenance and invalidation is persisted.
frames.notes: The UX-02 journey opened the evidence detail route; the acceptance journey verified invalidation through UI and API on desktop and the responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Preview and evaluate a named verification rule.
frames.expected_result: Blocked outcome, blockers, fingerprint and saved evaluation are visible and persisted.
frames.notes: Preview, evaluation, blockers, fingerprints and saved verification history passed in the full isolated desktop and responsive viewport acceptance run.
Current code exposes three fixed verification rules and no rule-configuration workflow.

frames.user_action: Open a saved verification result and inspect its trace.
frames.expected_result: Saved evaluation, blockers and staleness are shown.
frames.notes: The saved verification result and trace route were opened and asserted in the full isolated desktop and responsive viewport journey.

frames.user_action: Create a release candidate draft.
frames.expected_result: Candidate is stored at its initial revision and remains a draft until frozen.
frames.notes: Candidate creation, gate evaluation and freeze passed through the UI in the desktop and responsive viewport journeys.

frames.user_action: Evaluate release gates for a frozen candidate.
frames.expected_result: Gate result and candidate revision are recorded; blockers prevent manifest creation.
frames.notes: Blocked-to-pass gate progression and persisted gate evaluation passed in the full isolated desktop and responsive viewport run.

frames.user_action: Freeze a candidate, save its manifest and download JSON/Markdown.
frames.expected_result: Manifest bytes match saved state and explicitly remain NOT_PUBLISHED.
frames.notes: Manifest save, JSON/Markdown downloads and NOT_PUBLISHED semantics passed in the full isolated desktop and responsive viewport run.

frames.user_action: Choose a project JSON document for preview.
frames.expected_result: Document is parsed without committing records.
frames.notes: PA-TRN-001 passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile, including selecting a real downloaded project document for preview; behavior only, not native Desktop certification.

frames.user_action: Review schema, counts and fingerprint, then confirm import.
frames.expected_result: Planning-only records are committed after explicit confirmation.
frames.notes: PA-TRN-001 passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile; preview counts/fingerprint and explicit commit were verified against imported planning records.

frames.user_action: Recover from a blocked Desktop request while preserving the preview.
frames.expected_result: No partial project is created and actionable recovery is shown.
frames.notes: Native installed-app automation was not run; neither pywinauto nor uiautomation nor WinAppDriver is installed/available in this runner.

frames.user_action: Download the selected project's planning JSON.
frames.expected_result: Downloaded bytes contain the versioned planning snapshot and exclude operational evidence.
frames.notes: PA-TRN-001 passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile and validated the actual downloaded JSON bytes and schema.

frames.user_action: Search projects and toggle archived visibility.
frames.expected_result: Organization shows matching projects and their actual active/archived state.
frames.notes: Workspace list and project search/archived visibility behavior passed on desktop and mobile. PA-A11Y-01 verifies theme persistence, keyboard command navigation, focus restoration, and WCAG 2.1 A/AA axe scans; not visual Figma certification.

frames.user_action: Create a workspace in the empty state, then create a Project in a workspace.
frames.expected_result: New workspace/project records are persisted and shown by Organization.
frames.notes: Fresh-database first-use workspace and project creation passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.
The current route is a planning board, not this separate Project Home composition.

frames.user_action: Create an Epic and inspect its linked Features in the planning view.
frames.expected_result: The Epic and linked Feature appear in the planning overview.
frames.notes: Epic creation and summary behavior passed, but this frame suggests an Epic explorer and the product has no separate Epic detail route; no visual parity is claimed.

frames.user_action: Search planning Features and filter by status.
frames.expected_result: Only Features matching the search and status filters are displayed.
frames.notes: Search and status filtering passed in desktop/mobile acceptance journeys; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Create a Feature and associate it with an Epic.
frames.expected_result: The Feature is shown under the selected Epic and persists in the planning API.
frames.notes: Feature creation and Epic assignment passed in desktop/mobile journeys; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 07 · Detalle de Feature y Tasks
frames.user_action: Create Tasks, update Task status/order, and add acceptance criteria.
frames.expected_result: Changes persist and remain visible after reloading Feature detail.
frames.notes: Feature detail task/criterion operations and persistence passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 08 · Board con selector de estado
frames.user_action: Select a Feature status from the board card.
frames.expected_result: The Feature appears in the selected column and API state matches the selection.
frames.notes: Manual Feature status transition passed with API persistence checks on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 09 · Administración de Project y Workspace
frames.user_action: Archive or restore a Project.
frames.expected_result: Project status is updated while history is retained; workspace editing is not exposed in this UI.
frames.notes: Project archive/restore passed automated checks; workspace administration shown by this frame is not implemented. No full-frame parity is claimed.
No workspace/project delete workflow is present in the inspected Organization UI; deletion is not fabricated.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 11 · Board después del cambio de estado
frames.user_action: Change a Feature status and inspect its new board column.
frames.expected_result: The Feature is visible in the new status column and the API stores that status.
frames.notes: Board status movement passed with API persistence checks on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Show archived Projects and restore one.
frames.expected_result: The Project returns to active state and remains persisted.
frames.notes: Project archive/restore and API persistence passed on desktop and mobile; the frame's confirmation layout was not visual-certified.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 13 · Primer uso y estado vacío
frames.user_action: Create the first workspace from the empty state.
frames.expected_result: The new workspace replaces the empty state and is persisted.
frames.notes: First-use workspace creation passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 14 · Selector y gestión de Workspaces
frames.user_action: Select a workspace from the Organization workspace selector.
frames.expected_result: Organization loads projects for the selected workspace.
frames.notes: The journey selects its created workspace, but broader workspace management/editing shown in the frame is not exposed; no full-frame parity is claimed.

frames.user_action: Search Projects, include archived items, and restore a Project.
frames.expected_result: The filtered list reflects persisted project status.
frames.notes: Project search, archived visibility, restore, and persistence passed on desktop and mobile; not visual Figma certification.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 16 · Crear Project y elegir origen
frames.user_action: Create a Project.
frames.expected_result: A Project is created; source/origin selection is unavailable in the current UI.
frames.notes: Project creation is implemented and covered in the authored journey, but choosing an origin is not an available Organization control.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 17 · Detalle de Epic y Features vinculadas
frames.notes: Current code renders Epic summaries and linked Features in the planning board; no separate Epic detail route exists.

frames.user_action: Edit the Feature title, description, or goal and save.
frames.expected_result: The changed Feature fields persist in the API and after reload.
frames.notes: Feature editing exists in the UI but is not exercised by this shard's authored E2E journeys.

frames.user_action: Create Tasks, change Task status, and reorder Tasks.
frames.expected_result: Task status and order are retained in the API and after reload.
frames.notes: Task creation, status change, ordering, and SQLite-backed persistence passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Add an acceptance criterion to a Feature.
frames.expected_result: The criterion is visible and persists in the API and after reload.
frames.notes: Acceptance criterion creation and persisted API behavior passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Attempt a self-dependency, then create a valid Feature dependency.
frames.expected_result: The invalid self-link is not persisted; the valid relationship is persisted and displayed.
frames.notes: Self-dependency no-op and valid dependency persistence passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.
The inspected Organization/Planning/Readiness feature routes do not expose this global command/search screen.

frames.user_action: Search for a Feature query that has no match, then clear the query.
frames.expected_result: An empty result is shown and matching Features return when the query is cleared.
frames.notes: Empty search and restoration of search results passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Archive a Project using the current immediate Archive action.
frames.expected_result: Project status changes to archived; no confirmation dialog is currently shown.
frames.notes: Project archiving exists and is covered by the authored test; the Figma confirmation step is absent and is not fabricated.
No Workspace edit form or management route is exposed by the inspected Organization UI.

frames.screen_state: UX-00 / 26 · Error de carga y reintento
frames.user_action: Retry loading workspaces after the list request fails.
frames.expected_result: Organization retries the request and returns to the workspace view on success.
frames.notes: Retry control exists and component behavior has unit coverage, but no executable browser recovery journey is included in this shard.
Figma flow map is reference material, not a single executable product screen.
Current Feature detail supports Task creation, status, and ordering, but no Task deletion action.

frames.user_action: View Features in the Refining column.
frames.expected_result: The board shows Features whose current status is refining.
frames.notes: The status is supported by the current Planning UI but is not exercised by this shard's automated transition.

frames.user_action: View Features in the Ready column.
frames.expected_result: The board shows Features whose current status is ready.
frames.notes: The status is supported by the current Planning UI but is not exercised by this shard's automated transition.

frames.user_action: View Features in the Verify column.
frames.expected_result: The board shows Features whose current status is verify.
frames.notes: The status is supported by the current Planning UI but is not exercised by this shard's automated transition.

frames.user_action: View Features in the Done column.
frames.expected_result: The board shows Features whose current status is done.
frames.notes: The status is supported by the current Planning UI but is not exercised by this shard's automated transition.

frames.user_action: Move a Task up and inspect the updated Task order.
frames.expected_result: The API returns the new order and the UI retains it after reload.
frames.notes: Task reordering passed through UI and API on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Review and create a decision from feature-scoped Readiness.
frames.expected_result: Decision records are listed with their current status; there is no separate project Decisions inventory page.
frames.notes: Decision creation, linking, accepted state, and API persistence passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Create a decision, accept it, and open its revision history.
frames.expected_result: Accepted status and decision revision history are shown and persisted.
frames.notes: Decision acceptance and initial revision history passed on desktop/mobile. A reproduced case mismatch was fixed so Accept disappears for lowercase API status; not visual Figma certification.

frames.user_action: Review feature-scoped Invariants in Readiness.
frames.expected_result: Invariant statement, revision, and acknowledgement state are displayed; there is no separate project Invariants inventory screen.
frames.notes: Invariant creation, acknowledgement, and API persistence passed on desktop and mobile; visual Figma parity was not human-certified.

frames.user_action: Open Readiness and inspect the current deterministic planning preview.
frames.expected_result: The UI shows current readiness outcome and explicitly distinguishes planning from execution/delivery verification.
frames.notes: Readiness outcomes and the non-verification boundary passed on desktop and mobile; automated behavior only, not visual certification.
The inspected UI evaluates a live preview and does not expose a saved evaluation snapshot/history workflow for stale snapshot review.
The current Readiness UI creates and accepts Decisions but does not expose decision replacement/editing.
No Invariant retirement control is exposed in the inspected Readiness UI.

frames.user_action: Evaluate a Feature whose planning rules are satisfied.
frames.expected_result: Readiness preview reports READY_TO_START only when its rules pass.
frames.notes: READY_TO_START outcome was asserted after criterion, accepted decision, and invariant acknowledgement on desktop and mobile; no visual parity claim.

frames.user_action: Open the displayed Decision history.
frames.expected_result: Stored revisions are displayed without changing the current decision.
frames.notes: The authored journey opens history but only verifies the initial revision; a superseded historical revision is not created or certified.

frames.user_action: Create an Invariant for the current Feature and acknowledge its current revision.
frames.expected_result: Invariant and acknowledgement revision are persisted and visible after reload.
frames.notes: Invariant form, create/acknowledge actions, and SQLite-backed API persistence passed on desktop and mobile; not visual Figma certification.
Current UI renders an Invariant card but does not expose a separate detail/edit/retire route.

frames.expected_result: Provides a visual guide to journey categories; it is not a separate product route.
frames.notes: Figma footer identifies this as a UX guide whose links connect editable Figma screens; do not fabricate an application hub.

frames.user_action: Connect an authorized synthetic local repository.
frames.expected_result: The authorized repository appears in the project repository inventory.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Submit a repository path outside the authorized local root.
frames.expected_result: The path is rejected and no repository record is created.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Preview a feature Context Package.
frames.expected_result: A generated schema and fingerprint are displayed for review before save.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Open the Workbench Runs registry.
frames.expected_result: Recorded human-reported Runs are listed with their provenance.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Open a ready Handoff for human review.
frames.expected_result: The immutable revision and its reported provenance are available for review.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Review evidence records and provenance.
frames.expected_result: Evidence inventory distinguishes provenance and invalidation state.
frames.notes: Evidence inventory, provenance and invalidation behavior passed on desktop and the responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Evaluate checks and inspect blocking conditions.
frames.expected_result: Blocked outcomes and blockers are explicit and retained.
frames.notes: Verification and blocked-check journey passed on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport in the full isolated acceptance run.

frames.user_action: Review candidate gates and freeze state.
frames.expected_result: Gate result is revision-aware and manifest creation requires a current PASS.
frames.notes: Release candidate gate interactions passed on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport in the full isolated acceptance run.

frames.user_action: Export, review, import and confirm a project document.
frames.expected_result: Only validated planning data is imported; rejected documents cause no writes.
frames.notes: Focused Playwright run passed on chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile, including export/import and invalid-document no-partial-write assertions. This is automated behavior evidence, not human Figma certification.

frames.user_action: Inspect connected repository metadata and authorization boundaries.
frames.expected_result: Only the authorized synthetic root is connected and metadata is reported without reading source content.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Confirm a repository disconnection.
frames.expected_result: The disconnected state is shown while prior observations remain stored.
frames.notes: Figma text calls the post-action state simulated in the prototype; the current repository page disconnects directly and contains no confirmation dialog.

frames.user_action: Change feature context and request a fresh preview.
frames.expected_result: The new preview fingerprint differs while the previously saved snapshot remains immutable.
frames.notes: Fingerprint change and prior snapshot immutability passed in both Chromium projects; no dedicated stale badge is asserted.

frames.screen_state: UX-A / 14 · Context Package · Preview y guardado
frames.user_action: Preview and save a Context Package snapshot.
frames.expected_result: Saved snapshot history preserves its payload and exposes JSON and Markdown downloads.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.screen_state: UX-A / 15 · Agent Run · Detalle y eventos
frames.user_action: Inspect a Run detail and its activity timeline.
frames.expected_result: Events persist and render in chronological order as human-reported activity.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.screen_state: UX-A / 16 · Agent Run · Agregar evento y resultado
frames.user_action: Submit a valid activity event and attempt an invalid empty-title event.
frames.expected_result: The valid event appears in order; invalid input returns validation failure without an extra event record.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.user_action: Revise a draft, mark it ready, inspect revision history, and acknowledge it.
frames.expected_result: An immutable ready revision is reviewed and acknowledged by a named person.
frames.notes: Automated assertions passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile for the listed test IDs; this is behavior evidence, not human Figma visual certification.

frames.expected_result: A context-change conflict is communicated without silently changing the immutable Handoff revision.
frames.notes: Figma labels the error presentation as a simulation of optimistic revision control; no matching context-changed Handoff state is asserted by the current product UI.

frames.user_action: Register reported evidence.
frames.expected_result: The stored record remains REPORTED and is not asserted verified.
frames.notes: Reported evidence creation and API provenance assertions passed on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Inspect and invalidate evidence.
frames.expected_result: Invalidation is retained in backend state.
frames.notes: The UX-02 journey opened evidence detail, and the acceptance journey verified invalidation state on desktop and the responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Preview, evaluate and inspect verification history.
frames.expected_result: Outcome, blockers and stale status derive from recorded inputs.
frames.notes: Preview, evaluation and saved verification history passed on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Inspect blockers for a failed verification.
frames.expected_result: Missing active VERIFIED evidence is shown as a blocker.
frames.notes: The blocked outcome and missing VERIFIED-evidence blocker passed on desktop and the responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Create a release candidate draft.
frames.expected_result: Candidate persists with draft status and revision.
frames.notes: Candidate creation through the UI passed on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Freeze a candidate at its expected revision.
frames.expected_result: Frozen snapshot and fingerprint are retained.
frames.notes: Freeze and persisted candidate revision assertions passed on desktop and the responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Evaluate and diagnose release gates.
frames.expected_result: Gate outcome and blockers are retained for the current revision.
frames.notes: Gate outcome and blockers were evaluated and asserted on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Save and download the release manifest.
frames.expected_result: Actual JSON and Markdown downloads identify the artifact as NOT_PUBLISHED.
frames.notes: Manifest save and downloaded JSON/Markdown bytes with NOT_PUBLISHED status passed on desktop and the responsive viewport.

frames.screen_state: UX-A / 27 · Project Transfer · Recuperación y respaldo
frames.user_action: Recover from invalid transfer input without partial writes.
frames.expected_result: Error is visible and persisted project list remains unchanged.
frames.notes: Malformed JSON and invalid schema, fingerprint, reference and cycle inputs passed without partial writes on desktop and the responsive viewport.
Figma footer explicitly says this prototype result has no persistence or real transfer; it is not claimed as an application workflow test.

frames.user_action: Confirm evidence invalidation.
frames.expected_result: Record status changes to INVALIDATED and remains persisted.
frames.notes: Invalidation state was asserted in the UI and API on desktop and the 390px responsive viewport.

frames.user_action: Download a release manifest for review.
frames.expected_result: Download is a local planning artifact and does not publish or deploy.
frames.notes: Manifest downloads and NOT_PUBLISHED/non-deployment language passed on desktop and the responsive viewport.
